name: Generate synthetic MP-RAGE T1 image from clinical FLAIR data
summary: Synthesises a 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image from a clinical FLAIR image with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthSR (mri_synthsr).
description: Runs mri_synthsr on a clinical FLAIR image of any resolution or orientation to produce a synthetic 1 mm MP-RAGE T1w volume. Use it to make clinical or low-resolution scans usable by T1w-based tools such as FreeSurfer or segmentation Apps. The output is a synthetic image, not a measurement, and should not be used for quantitative intensity analyses.

inputs.description: Clinical FLAIR image (NIfTI); any resolution, contrast and orientation accepted by SynthSR.

outputs.description: Synthetic 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image.

parameters.description: Base name of the output image file (<type>.nii.gz); leave as t1.

citations.text: Iglesias JE, Billot B, Balbastre Y, et al. Joint super-resolution and synthesis of 1mm isotropic MP-RAGE volumes from clinical MRI exams with scans of different orientation, resolution and contrast. NeuroImage 237, 118206 (2021).

Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.cause: mri_synthsr did not write the output image.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for mri_synthsr errors.
Provide a FreeSurfer license in the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable.
